request: Fix and verify recovery-write cancellation on conversation navigation without losing drafts or weakening lock/workspace guards
acceptance: Leaving a conversation durably saves its captured draft to the original workspace/session, without a navigation cancellation failure notice; switching back/reload restores exact text.
New-session navigation preserves outgoing draft and records the empty scene without reopening the prior conversation on reload.
Lock, recovery epoch and workspace changes still prevent stale writes; genuine storage failures remain visible; no cross-session draft overwrite.
Canonical start.command actual Safari input/switch/reload checks, focused JS and quick regression, docs/source push and current offline package.

requirements.summary: Continue continuity goal after real navigation cancellation notice in plugin UI acceptance; exact typed draft loss not yet proven.

design.summary: Captured outgoing draft uses lock/epoch/workspace guard rather than current session identity; switch ownership before attachment rendering can synchronously cache destination draft. New-session records destination scene immediately. No await added to navigation; real errors still surfaced.

implementation.summary: Implemented immutable captured-session save guard, destination owner before rendering/cache, immediate empty scene persistence, app cache147. Regression uses actual application functions with delayed storage, separate per-session snapshots and lock/workspace/epoch invalidation.

verification.summary: Actual pre-fix Safari9999 reproduces cancelled-write toast; entered text does not return to composer after switching and reload, but remains offered as another recovery branch (not total data loss).
